rv.q: By the end of this knotty and chilling thrill ride of a play, you may feel as if you've taken a 3D trip into the Palintir manifesto.
Hypocrisy is a nasty taste, and I left the theater not just unsatisfied but a little angry.
In the end, Static Head is a production caught between a compelling concept and incomplete execution.

cn.t: Critics find Static-Head's AI critique timely but undermined by ironic lack of originality and weak narrative flow, with the production failing to practice the creative innovation it preaches.
